## Research (agent, M5): Tormach 1300PL plasma, from public sources only

**Sources:**
- **[UM]** Tormach *1300PL Operator's Manual* UM10720, v1223A: https://tormach.com/media/asset/u/m/um10720_1300pl_1223a_web.pdf (printed page numbers).
- **[PG]** Tormach *PathPilot Post Processor Guidelines*: https://knowledgebase.tormach.com/8l/pathpilot-post-processor-guidelines (its plasma column).
- **[SS]** the 1300PL spec sheet (03/24).
- General plasma practice: LinuxCNC's Plasma Primer and QtPlasmaC docs, and Hypertherm's cut-quality article.

No commercial CAM post or its output was used as a source.

**1. Machine:**
- **Travels:** X 50 / Y 51.5 / Z 3.9 in ([UM] §2.2.1 p.17). **[SS] says X 48.5 / Y 50**, so the conflict is recorded and the smaller figures are taken (they can only refuse a job, never pass a bad one).
- **Feeds:** 1000 IPM on X and Y, 120 IPM on Z ([UM] p.16). No separate rapid figure is published.
- **Hardware:** Hypertherm Powermax 45/65/85/105, arc-voltage THC, ohmic and touch IHS, arc-ok, a breakaway torch ([SS]; [UM] §4.12.8, §5.5).
- **Controller:** PathPilot ≥ 2.4. It is LinuxCNC-based but **not QtPlasmaC**, and Tormach says stock LinuxCNC posts "lack the specific M- and G-codes that PathPilot uses".

**2. Dialect** ([UM] §7.1–7.2 pp.54–55; [PG]):
- **Cycle words:**
  - `G15` probes Z to the work and sets the WCS Z to 0;
  - `G16` raises to the pierce height, fires, waits the delay (and arc-ok), drops to cut height and **enables THC**;
  - `M200` (AutoFS) applies feed, THC volts, pierce height and delay, and amps from the material chosen in the UI;
  - `M205` stops the torch and returns to G30 Z;
  - `M207`/`M208`/`M209`/`M210`/`M211` set pierce height, cut height, pierce delay, THC volts and amps by hand;
  - `M212` sets the mode and `M213` the air pressure.
- **Not supported on plasma:** M3/M4/M5/M7/M8/M9 ([PG]).
- **Tool call:** `G43 H1` always. Tool 1 is the torch.
- **Cutter comp:** G41/G42 (D optional) and G41.1/G42.1 are supported, with a **straight G1 entry longer than the tool radius**.
- **Not supported:** G95/G96. **G64 P must be in inches.** No `%` delimiters.
- **No documented code locks or disables THC mid-cut** (corners, holes).
- **Example** ([UM] p.50): `G90 / G64 P0.005 Q0.005 / G17 / G54 / T1 M6 G43 H1 / G30 / G0 X0 Y0 / M200 / G15 / G16 / G1 … / M205 / G30`. The manual uses M6 there, while [PG] lists M6 as unsupported; that conflict stays open.

**3. What the CAM writes:** a **2D XY path only, with no Z**. Each contour is wrapped as `G0` to the lead-in start, then `M200` (or M207–M211 plus F), `G15`, `G16`, the path, `M205`, `G30`. The controller owns every Z move ([UM] §6.3 p.51).

**4. Practice:**
- **Direction:** outside contours CW, inside CCW, which keeps the square edge on the part (Hypertherm).
- **Small holes:** for Ø ≲ 32–37 mm or under 1.5× thickness, use 60–70 % feed, a perpendicular lead-in from near the centre, and **no lead-out** (overburn instead). There's a 1300PL forum report of arc-loss with hole lead-outs.
- **Leads:** arc leads by default, with internal leads no longer than the hole radius.
- **Kerf:** ≈ 1.5× the nozzle orifice, confirmed by a test cut (Tormach KB).

**5. Safety:**
- **Tip-ups:** these are the hazard ([UM] §1.4.2), and the breakaway torch stops motion.
- **Rapids:** these run at the G30 Z the operator sets above the slats (§4.13). The post must emit G30 after each M205 and at start and end.
- **Kerf crossings:** crossing an earlier cut's kerf makes THC dive, so cut order matters: inner contours first, and no path through cut voids.

**Not public:** a rapid figure; a THC-lock code; anti-dive; the kerf variable behind G41 D; lead length versus kerf; the M6 conflict; metric support beyond the G64 rule.

**Sub-issues filed:** see the next comment.

**Sub-issues filed:**
- **#669:** the plasma machine kind and the 1300PL machine file.
- **#670:** the plasma profile operation.
- **#671:** the PathPilot plasma post.
- **#672:** the plasma verification laws.

**Build order:** #669, then #670 and #672, then #671. The post needs the op and the laws, and stays refused until #672 holds.

## Research update (clean-room audit)

Prior research under this issue filed #669, #670, #671, and #672.
All four sub-issues are now closed and shipped.
Follow-up issues #801, #998, #1053, #1195, #1250, #1266, and #1596 also shipped.
Open issues #924, #1389, #1447, and #1521 already track separate plasma enhancements.
This comment answers all five questions against current code and public specifications, and lists two remaining gaps.

### Answers to open questions

1. **Operation (`OpType::PlasmaProfile`):**
   - `Plasma Profile` cuts through the plate in one pass with no depth steps (`crates/app/src/operation/types/plasma.rs`, `crates/motion/src/plasma/mod.rs`).
   - It uses `top_z` and `bottom_z` only to calculate plate thickness for the small-hole rule.
   - A `ToolKind::Torch` tool stores kerf width as its `diameter` (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs`, `assets/tools/catalog.json` `PT-KERF-150`), and the operation can override `kerf`.
   - `PlasmaComp::Computer` offsets the torch center path with arc leads, while `PlasmaComp::Control` outputs the part contour with a straight lead of at least half the kerf (`site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md`).
   - By default, outer contours run clockwise and holes run counterclockwise to keep the square edge on the part (Hypertherm cut-direction guidance; `reversed` swaps both).
   - Holes below `small_hole_dia` (`32.0` mm default) or `1.5` times thickness pierce near the center, use `small_hole_feed` (`0.65` default), omit lead-out, and allow `overburn` (LinuxCNC Plasma Primer section 13).

2. **Torch control and THC (`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps`):**
   - PathPilot plasma uses `M200` for AutoFS material settings, optional `M207 P` (pierce height), `M208 P` (cut height), and `M209 P` (pierce delay in seconds), `G15` (ohmic touch-off probe setting WCS Z to 0), `G16` (pierce, delay, move to cut height, enable THC), and `M205` (torch off and retract to G30 height) (Tormach UM10720 sections 6.2, 6.3, 7.1, and 7.2; PathPilot v2.14.4 Hub SIM run in PR #679).
   - UM10720 section 7.2 also defines `M210` (THC target voltage), `M211` (amps), `M212` (cut mode), and `M213` (air pressure), which open issue #1521 tracks with material cut charts.
   - Public Tormach 1300PL and PathPilot documentation define no M-code or G-code to lock or disable THC mid-cut around corners or holes.
   - PathPilot manages corner anti-dive internally via its Velocity Locking and UI THC settings, while CamCraft reduces feed on small holes (`Small hole feed`) and warns on `KerfCrossing`.

3. **Machine kind (`Kind::Plasma`):**
   - `assets/machines/tormach-1300pl.mch` declares `"kind": "plasma"`, inch units, X `-48.5..48.5` (1000 IPM), Y `-50.0..50.0` (1000 IPM), Z `-3.9..3.9` (120 IPM), `number_of_tools: 1`, and no spindle, coolant, rotary, or `safe_retract`.
   - `crates/post/src/machine/plasma.rs` (`plasma_refusals`, `Machine::plasma_sane`) rejects spindle, live-tool, coolant, and rotary keys on plasma machines.
   - `crates/app/src/machine/plasma.rs` (`check_plasma_ops`) checks X and Y limits, refuses non-plasma operations or nonzero rpm, and skips spindle power and Z depth limits.
   - `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` (`plan_program`) skips `ToolKind::Torch`, and `crates/app/src/posting_plasma.rs` (`plasma_clause`) enforces the 2D through-cut laws at the post gate (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`).

4. **Post (`Tormach PathPilot Plasma`):**
   - `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` registers in `PLASMA_POSTS` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`) and serves only `Kind::Plasma` machines (`#1266`).
   - Unlike the mill post, it emits `G90 G91.1 G94 G17 G40 G49 G80`, writes `G64 P0.005 Q0.005` in inches even under `G21`, writes `G43 H1` without `M6`, omits `%` and `;`, forbids `S`/`M3`-`M9`/`G81`-`G89`/`G95`/rotary/Z-cut moves, wraps each contour in `G0 X Y` -> `M200` -> `[M207/M208/M209]` -> `G15` -> `G16` -> XY cuts -> `M205` -> `G30`, and formats dynamic cutter compensation as `G41.1`/`G42.1 D<kerf>` ... `G40` before straight leads (Tormach PathPilot Post Processor Guidelines; UM10720).
   - Issue #1596 audited `G30` in `tormach-plasma.cps` and kept it intentionally for PathPilot plasma traverse height.
   - PR #679 ran the inch, metric, and control-comp golden files to `M30` on PathPilot v2.14.4 Hub SIM, but left four runtime checks unmeasured: `M207`/`M208` units under `G21`, `M207`/`M209` overriding `M200` AutoFS, feedless `G1` taking AutoFS feed, and `G41.1` offset side.

5. **Safety laws (`crates/sim/src/verify/plasma/`):**
   - Generation (`crates/motion/src/plasma/mod.rs`) refuses self-intersecting loops, kerf gouges, and zero-width slits (`#801`), and warns on shortened leads or reversed cut directions.
   - The post gate (`crates/sim/src/verify/plasma/mod.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting_plasma.rs`) blocks on `CutOrder` (hole cut after enclosing outline), `CutCrossing`, and `Malformed` records, and warns on `KerfCrossing` (entering within one kerf of an earlier kerf) and `TipUp` (rapid crossing a freed cutout).
   - Reduced-fidelity STEP/STL models tighten `kerf_tol` per `#1053`.

### Design proposal (smallest useful slice first)

Core machine, operation, safety laws, and post slices (#669-#672) are already complete.
Two small unfiled slices remain under #621:

1. **First slice (agent surface parity, required by project rules):** Add an MCP integration test (`crates/app/tests/mcp_plasma.rs`) covering `Tormach 1300PL`, `PT-KERF-150`, `Plasma Profile`, `verify`, and `post`. Update `s_post` in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` to include `Tormach PathPilot Plasma`, and add a Plasma Profile guide section to `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. Zero plasma references currently exist in `crates/app/src/mcp/`, `crates/app/tests/*mcp*`, or `camcraft-mcp`.
2. **Second slice (hardware verification and post notes):** Confirm the four open PathPilot v2.14.4 behaviors noted in PR #679 (`G21` units on `M207`/`M208`, `M200` AutoFS overrides and feedless `G1`, `G41.1` offset side), fix unit output if needed, and document the harmless on-load `M207` Z-max warning in `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md`.

### Concrete sub-issues to file

1. **Title:** `MCP: Plasma Profile, Torch tool, and Tormach 1300PL workflow test and docs`
   - **What it does:** Adds an end-to-end headless MCP test for `Plasma Profile` on `Tormach 1300PL`, lists `Tormach PathPilot Plasma` in `tools.rs`, and documents the plasma workflow in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.
   - **Done means:** `crates/app/tests/mcp_plasma.rs` passes `load_machine`, `add_tool`, `add_operation`, `edit_operation`, `generate`, `verify`, `undo`/`redo`, and `post`; `s_post` schema text and `SKILL.md` name `Tormach PathPilot Plasma` and `Plasma Profile`.
   - **Priority:** `P5` | **Effort:** `effort:medium` | **Area:** `area:mcp`

2. **Title:** `Plasma: verify PathPilot v2.14.4 G21 M207/M208 units, AutoFS overrides, and G41.1 kerf side`
   - **What it does:** Confirms the four unmeasured PathPilot v2.14.4 1300PL checks recorded on PR #679, updates `tormach-plasma.cps` if `M207`/`M208` units differ under `G21`, and documents the `M207` Z-limit load warning.
   - **Done means:** Hub or hardware checks confirm `M207`/`M208` units under `G21`, `M200` override and AutoFS feed behavior, and `G41.1` side; any post fix has passing golden tests; `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md` notes the `M207` load warning.
   - **Priority:** `P7` | **Effort:** `effort:low` | **Area:** `area:post`
